attachments.more: NTX Webinar - EEG &amp; BCI in VR/AR/MR<br><br>Signup : <https://goo.gl/forms/jVEgh7o5mEkZgwe03<br><br><br><br><br><br><b>Abstract</b><br>Virtual> and Augmented Reality is just getting started and some companies are already trying to embed EEG sensors in these VR/AR headsets. Join us for a discussion with InteraXon and Neurable on the current state of EEG in VR and the potential of the field.<br><br>Prepare your questions!<br>What would you like to know? Do you have an application in mind?<br><br><br><br><b>About NTX Webinars</b><br><br>Each month NTX will be hosting a free webinar on neurotech-related subjects.<br>Join us online to meet and discuss with neurotech enthusiasts and experts.<br>For Previous Webinars, click here.<br><br>https://neurotechx.com/webinars/
